component.name: CCTV Viewer
component.summary: Watch four cameras from your home recorder

description.p: Watch four live camera channels from a CP PLUS recorder in an adaptive GNOME interface. Focus on one camera or keep all four visible in a grid.

ul.li: Watch all four cameras in a grid or focus on one camera.
Listen to camera audio and save snapshots.
Discover RTSP services on your home network.
Optionally save your login in the desktop keyring.

description.p: Uses the CP PLUS realmonitor RTSP path. Other recorder protocols, archive playback, and InstaOn P2P connections are not supported.

screenshot.caption: Four-camera grid in light appearance with demonstration feeds
Video quality, appearance, and camera naming preferences

ul.li: Respect Disconnect and Forget Saved Login while a saved login is loading.
Discover cameras on local networks without a default gateway.
Fix desktop launchers for checkout paths containing special characters.

description.p: Initial Flatpak package with live video, audio, snapshots, and discovery.
